songs.title: 동글 네모 세모!
songs.style: bouncy kids hip-hop, 95 bpm, boom-bap drums, wood block 'tok' sounds, toy piano, rhythmic chant-rap verses with a sung chorus, friendly male lead, toddler sing-along kids song, Korean lyrics, clear slow pronunciation, simple catchy melody with small note range, kids choir echoes the short shouts in brackets, major key

[Chorus]
쿵쿵 쾅! 쿵쿵 쾅!
동글 네모 세모 (모양!)

동글동글 창문

하늘색 동그라미 (동그라미!)

[Verse 4]
뾰족 세모 지붕
어디 있을까? (어디 있지?)
세모 세모 (세모!)

[Chorus]
쿵쿵 쾅! 쿵쿵 쾅!
동글 네모 세모 (모양!)
